Instant replay: keep the last seconds in memory and save them on demand

Usage: lys-shell recorder replay <COMMAND>

Commands:
  start  Arm the instant replay
  stop   Disarm the instant replay and free its memory
  save   Save the last seconds to a file and print its path
  help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
